issue.title: test_agents_task_bead_notes_png_snapshot: the zoomed BEAD lane drops the Size: row before the PNG comparison
issue.description:
FOUND BY the sase-y5.12 land agent while triaging the epic's `just check-full && just test-visual` landing gate on 2026-09-09 at master HEAD cef06cdca.

`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_sase_context.py::test_agents_task_bead_notes_png_snapshot` fails on a plain content assertion, not a PNG comparison:

    assert "Task Title:" in svg_plain   # passes
    assert "Description:" in svg_plain  # passes
    assert "Notes:" in svg_plain        # passes
    assert "Size:" in svg_plain         # FAILS

The test builds a task BeadSummary with `size="medium"`, `bead_type="task"`, and a two-entry notes blob, presses `z z` to zoom the BEAD lane, waits for the note text ("alice", "attribution readable") and for visual idle, then exports the SVG. `Task Title:`, `Description:` and `Notes:` are all present in the exported frame; only the `Size:` row is missing, and the frame ends at the modal's `dismiss` footer.

The row is not conditionally suppressed for this fixture: `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_bead_section.py::_rows` appends `(self._label("Size"), self._size_value())` for `bead_type == "task"` whenever `self.summary.size is not None`, and this summary's size is `"medium"`. So either the zoom modal is clipping the rows that follow the expanded `Notes:` block, or the ordering/inclusion of the Size row regressed. Triage needs to decide which, and fix the widget if rows are being dropped rather than only rebaselining or relaxing the test.

Deterministic and not caused by any pending change:
- Reproduced twice on 2026-09-09, once inside the full 14-worker `just test-visual` run (35 failed / 862 passed) and once in an isolated re-run of only the failing node IDs (33 failed / 2 passed). It was not one of the two nodes that flipped to passing in isolation.
- Reproduced a third time after reverting the entire sase-y5.12 src diff (`git checkout 4068437a2 -- src/`), which fails identically, so it predates that epic.

Reproduce:

    just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_sase_context.py::test_agents_task_bead_notes_png_snapshot

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed in three independent runs on 2026-09-09: the full 14-worker just test-visual lane, an isolated re-run of only the 35 failing node IDs (where two other nodes did flip to passing, so the lane's real flakes were separated out), and a fourth run against pre-epic source with the sase-y5.12 src diff reverted. It also fails on a hard content assertion (assert "Size:" in svg_plain) rather than a pixel comparison, so there is no renderer or timing tolerance involved.
